descricao_original: This electron micrograph shows a portion of a glomerulus, separated from the parietal layer of Bowman’s capsule by Bowman’s space. The parietal layer consists of a simple squamous epithelium, which is continuous with the visceral layer (podocytes) at the vascular pole of the glomerulus. 4000x
